purpose: Prospectively test whether a gold-free role-argmax cardinality stop rule corrects the evidence-precision dilution observed after the frozen v42 SciFact result, using an untouched structured/unstructured multi-hop dataset.

allowed_pre_registration_information: official schema and scorer source code
official repository tree filenames and pinned revision
HTTP status, content length, content type, and last-modified headers

source_access_order: write implementation registration with all code hashes
download development annotations and official baseline predictions
deterministically select IDs without exporting gold into blind caches
download and verify the official Wikipedia database archive
prepare the complete blind candidate cache
write execution registration with source hashes and runtime
generate atomic queries and score every prepared case
validate complete ordered caches and only then join gold evidence
evaluate once and publish the result regardless of sign

eligible_before_sampling: row has an integer id and nonempty claim
row has at least one nonempty official evidence set
matching official baseline row has at least one predicted evidence page
id is not a permanently excluded documentation example
dataset_scope.sampling_rule: Within each challenge stratum, sort eligible rows by SHA-256 of 'FRC-FEVEROUS-V43|' plus the decimal id, then by id, and take the first 40.

blind_candidate_construction.candidate_pages: Unique page names in official baseline predicted_evidence, preserving first occurrence; no gold page fallback is permitted.
blind_candidate_construction.unit_text: Page title, active section path, local table/list context, and element value are deterministically linearized from the pinned Wikipedia database.
blind_candidate_construction.pool_rule: Union the first 80 BM25-ranked units with every valid official baseline predicted evidence unit; deduplicate by canonical evidence id and sort by BM25 rank then canonical id.

frozen_models.revisions: Inherited byte-for-byte from the registered v41 scorer and resolved local snapshots; offline loading is mandatory.

candidate_method_formula: For each of the four frozen dynamic atomic roles, find the candidate with maximum role score, breaking ties by canonical id.
Let target_cardinality be the number of distinct argmax candidate ids, clamped to [1, 5].
Run the unchanged v41 dynamic rank-coverage greedy objective and deterministic tie-breaking, but stop after target_cardinality selected units or when the token budget has no eligible unit.
No score threshold, label, challenge, gold count, candidate ceiling, or development-set statistic may alter target_cardinality.

evaluation.primary_metric: mean across budgets of FEVEROUS-style evidence macro F1
evaluation.macro_precision: Mean per-case fraction of selected evidence ids present in the union of gold evidence sets; empty prediction precision is 1.
evaluation.macro_recall: Mean per-case indicator that at least one complete gold evidence set is contained in the selected ids.
evaluation.macro_f1: Harmonic mean of macro precision and macro recall.

decision_rules.gate_2: Always remains NO-GO/SHADOW in v43; this bounded-pool selector test alone cannot authorize CANARY or DEFAULT.
decision_rules.publication: Publish favorable, null, negative, or inconclusive results with hashes and exclusions.
